notes: «وَ بِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ» takes over prev1's chain up to Sulayman b. Umar (the text names him again). Prev1 names Ali b. Babawayh's «أبي» and Sa'd b. Abd Allah; its three co-transmitters at one level; then al-Husayn b. Sayf. Prev1 continues to Muhajir and Zayd b. Arqam; this report does not take that part, and the back-reference is not written separately.
«قال سمعت حذيفه يقول» makes Huzayfa the Companion whose words the saying relays: the last link.
